title: CreateWebhookRequest
description: Request body for creating a webhook.

url.description: The URL endpoint that will receive webhook POST requests
url.title: Url

enabled_events.description: List of event types to subscribe to. Valid values: 'ai_note.shared_to_channel', 'ai_note.generated', 'action_item.assigned', 'action_item.completed'.
enabled_events.title: Enabled Events

description.description: Optional description for this webhook endpoint
description.title: Description

scope.description: Who the webhook belongs to. 'user' is the authenticated user, the default and the existing behaviour. 'workspace' is the whole account: it receives every matching event with no per-user filter, and each event is delivered once rather than once per attendee. Creating one requires a privileged API key.
scope.title: Scope
